name: commapump
description: Hear just-intonation music drift out of tune — an interactive explainer of the syntonic comma pump.

scripts.build: astro build && node scripts/build-applet.mjs && node scripts/make-manifest.mjs && node scripts/make-preview.mjs && node scripts/size-check.mjs
scripts.deploy:applet: npm run build && gcloud storage rsync site/ gs://luke-sarfas-applets/commapump/ --recursive --delete-unmatched-destination-objects && gcloud storage objects update "gs://luke-sarfas-applets/commapump/applet/**" "gs://luke-sarfas-applets/commapump/*.html" "gs://luke-sarfas-applets/commapump/manifest.json" --cache-control="public, max-age=300"
scripts.deploy:site: SITE_BASE=/luke-sarfas-applets/commapump-site/ astro build && gcloud storage rsync dist/ gs://luke-sarfas-applets/commapump-site/ --recursive --delete-unmatched-destination-objects && gcloud storage objects update "gs://luke-sarfas-applets/commapump-site/_astro/**" --cache-control="public, max-age=31536000, immutable" && gcloud storage objects update "gs://luke-sarfas-applets/commapump-site/**/*.html" "gs://luke-sarfas-applets/commapump-site/manifest.json" --cache-control="public, max-age=300"
